title: Pure lswarm
summary: lswarm cards only (Evilswarm, with the Steelswarm cards that share the name), plus staples and an automatic Extra Deck. The page's Fiendsmith engine is left out. lswarm is a DARK Level 4 deck that makes Rank 4 Xyz and locks the opponent out of big summons. Evilswarm Castor grants a second lswarm Normal Summon, and Evilswarm Kerykeion recovers an lswarm and grants another. Evilswarm Mandragora summons itself when they have more monsters. Two of them make Evilswarm Ophion: while it has material, Level 5 or higher monsters can't be Special Summoned, and it searches an Infestation Spell/Trap. Infestation Infection swaps an lswarm for one from the Deck each turn. Infestation Pandemic protects your lswarm from Spells/Traps, and Infestation Terminus bounces two of their cards. Evilswarm Ouroboros is Forbidden.
